sections.overview: Tourism, medical treatment, conferences, and business meetings.
sections.eligibility: Applicants must demonstrate strong ties to their home country (family, employment, assets) and clear intent to return.
sections.financialRequirements: $215 per day of planned stay. Last 3-6 months showing consistent income. Must demonstrate legal origin of large deposits.
sections.validity: Up to 10 years (reciprocal for Indian passport holders).
sections.rightsAndRestrictions: B1/B2 visa does not permit unauthorized employment or long-term residence.
